text: There is a simple but effective ritual of “crossing the threshold.” When entering home, do not immediately get pulled into discussing pressing matters with your household (some people love to pour a bucket of problems and bad emotions over the person entering from the doorway). Hang up your bag, take off your shoes, take 3 slow inhales and exhales, feel your feet on the floor. Then become aware that this is your home, feel its special energy, feel what it is like today, how you feel in it... And now the most important thing - greet your home with love. And notice the response that comes to you! This seems simple, but this way you will relax and rest better at home. If you start doing this regularly, then there will be fewer quarrels and conflicts in the family, your mood at home will improve, and you will sleep and recover better.
